instruction: Turn on the video color adjustment filter and set the saturation to 2.0.

criteria.script: async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: '.config/vlc/vlcrc', format: 'key_value', key: 'video-filter', default: '' } ] }); return data[0]; }
async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: '.config/vlc/vlcrc', format: 'key_value', key: 'saturation', default: '1.000000' } ] }); return data[0]; }
